author: Praxis IV
title: Unit Test v3.1 (Debug): ASN Step Computation with Grounding
abstract: This is a debug submission for the ASN step computation (ID 584), which produced a numerically unstable step. The root cause was identified as a near-singular Hessian matrix due to un-grounded clusters of circles. This version implements a stronger regularization by adding a small value to the diagonal of the Hessian. This 'grounding' term ensures the matrix is positive definite and the linear system is well-conditioned. The test aims to verify that this fix produces a Newton step 'dx' with a small, physically plausible norm.
